ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the circuit diagram, point P is the common node of the three resistor branches. The upper node A is connected to P through a 10Ω resistor; the left node B is connected to P through a 20Ω resistor; the lower node C is connected to P through a 10Ω resistor. Reasoning: Let the potential of point P be VP. Write KCL at node P: the algebraic sum of the currents flowing out of P to A, B, and C is 0, namely (VP - VA)/10 + (VP - VB)/20 + (VP - VC)/10 = 0. Substitute VA = 30 V, VB = 20 V, VC = -10 V, obtaining (VP - 30)/10 + (VP - 20)/20 + (VP + 10)/10 = 0. Multiply both sides by 20: 2(VP - 30) + (VP - 20) + 2(VP + 10) = 0, simplifying gives 5VP - 60 = 0, so VP = 12 V.

推理：设点 P 的电位为 VP。按节点 P 写 KCL：流出 P 到 A、B、C 的电流代数和为 0，即 (VP - VA)/10 + (VP - VB)/20 + (VP - VC)/10 = 0。代入 VA = 30 V，VB = 20 V，VC = -10 V，得到 (VP - 30)/10 + (VP - 20)/20 + (VP + 10)/10 = 0。两边乘以 20：2(VP - 30) + (VP - 20) + 2(VP + 10) = 0，化简得 5VP - 60 = 0，所以 VP = 12 V。

method.method_draft: Replace the two 10 Ω branches to A and C by their Thévenin equivalent at P. Since A = 30 V and C = -10 V with equal 10 Ω resistors, the open-circuit midpoint voltage is (30 + (-10))/2 = 10 V. With A and C ideal voltage sources shorted, the equivalent resistance is 10 Ω || 10 Ω = 5 Ω. Now P is connected to 20 V at B through 20 Ω and to a 10 V Thévenin source through 5 Ω. The current between 20 V and 10 V is (20 - 10)/(20 + 5) = 0.4 A, so VP = 20 - 0.4×20 = 12 V, equivalently 10 + 0.4×5 = 12 V.
method.CoT_raw:

推理：按指定方法，把 P 到 A、C 的两个 10 Ω 支路作 Thévenin 等效。由于 A = 30 V、C = -10 V，且两个电阻相等，开路时中点电压为 (30 + (-10)) / 2 = 10 V。将理想电压源 A、C 短路后，等效电阻为 10 Ω || 10 Ω = 5 Ω。因此 P 现在等效为通过 5 Ω 接到 10 V 的 Thévenin 源，同时通过 20 Ω 接到 B 的 20 V 源。20 V 与 10 V 之间的电流为 (20 - 10) / (20 + 5) = 0.4 A。于是 P 点电压为 VP = 20 - 0.4 × 20 = 12 V，也等于 10 + 0.4 × 5 = 12 V。
